summary: Full stack developer at CS Soft Solutions, where I started as a trainee in June 2022 and have been on the team since. I build web platforms for clients in fintech, health tech, AI SaaS, logistics and government, mostly React and Next.js on the front end, Node, NestJS and AWS behind it.
metaTitle: Résumé — Sarvjeet Thakur, full stack developer
metaDescription: The full résumé of Sarvjeet Thakur, full stack developer at CS Soft Solutions since 2022: experience, key projects and technical skills. Printable, with a PDF download.

bullets: Build end-to-end web applications for clients across fintech, health tech, AI marketing and the public sector, from requirements through to production release.
Write component-driven front ends in React, Next.js, TypeScript and Redux Toolkit, with Tailwind and SCSS design systems that keep the UI consistent across products.
Develop REST APIs and services in Node.js, NestJS and Express against MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Implement serverless workflows on AWS Lambda and containerise services with Docker.
Engineer role-based access control, authentication and audit logging for consoles handling financial, clinical and government data.
Work in Agile sprints with distributed teams, reviewing code and writing the specifications that keep scope agreed.
Six-month traineeship: learned the team's stack and review process, and shipped my first production features.
Moved onto client delivery work at the end of it and joined the team permanently.

strengths.label: Problem solving
strengths.text: I chase a bug across the stack rather than patching the symptom I can see.

strengths.label: Technical communication
strengths.text: I translate between stakeholders and engineers, and write the decision down.

strengths.label: Client focus
strengths.text: Most of my work is for international clients, delivered against their deadlines.

strengths.label: Code review
strengths.text: I review carefully and expect the same, because it is cheaper than the alternative.
